results.title: TROOPS KILL 2 LAKURAWA FIGHTERS, RECOVER 4 AK-47 RIFLES IN SOKOTO Troops of Operation Fansan Yamma killed two suspected Lakurawa terrorists
results.description:
TROOPS KILL 2 LAKURAWA FIGHTERS, RECOVER 4 AK-47 RIFLES IN SOKOTO

Troops of Operation Fansan Yamma killed two suspected Lakurawa terrorists during clearance operations at Waria Forest and Sarma Village in Sokoto on October 15. The operation also yielded four AK-47 rifles, eight motorcycles, ammunition, four magazines and communication equipment.

results.title: 🇳🇬🪖 OPERATIONAL BRIEF: OP FANSAN YAMMA EXTRACTS 27 KIDNAP VICTIMS; SOKOTO FOREST ENCLAVES CLEARED Joint Task Forces are recording rapid tact
results.description:
🇳🇬🪖 OPERATIONAL BRIEF: OP FANSAN YAMMA EXTRACTS 27 KIDNAP VICTIMS; SOKOTO FOREST ENCLAVES CLEARED

Joint Task Forces are recording rapid tactical victories across the North-West and South-South. And the message is clear: We are coming for the criminals. We are bringing our people home.

KEY OPERATIONAL VICTORIES:

🛑 KATSINA RAPID RESCUE (OP FANSAN YAMMA): Troops responded swiftly to a distress call in Sabuwa LGA, Katsina State. They engaged fleeing hostiles in a gunfight and safely rescued 27 kidnapped citizens including a 6-month-old infant. Twenty-seven lives. One baby. One rescue. One reason to keep fighting.

🛑 SOKOTO FOREST CLEARANCE: Sector 2 clearance teams engaged Lakurawa/terrorist elements in Waria Forest, Sokoto. Combatants neutralized. Recovered: 4 AK-47 rifles and 8 operational motorcycles.

🛑 MARITIME ANTI-CRUDE THEFT: Nigerian Navy riverine details in Oteghele, Delta State, uncovered and confiscated 75,000 litres of stolen crude oil. Another blow to economic sabotage.

Relentless pursuit guarantees no criminal enclave remains safe.

This is what victory looks like. This is the Nigerian Army of today.

🙏🇳🇬God bless our gallant troops. God bless Nigeria.
